purpose: Detects repeated position sequences (patterns) in shuttle tracks that are too common to be ordinary video footage. It identifies frames with fabricated, suspect flat, or degraded tracking data by analyzing recurrence attractors — positions that the shuttle returns to repeatedly — and assigns each frame a uint8 grade code.

public_api.name: pattern_episodes
public_api.role: Groups exact position windows (fixed-frame sequences) by their coordinate hash and counts how many separated episodes (time-distant occurrences) each pattern has. Called during analysis to find candidate repeated sequences.

public_api.name: adaptive_threshold
public_api.role: Derives the episode threshold that separates common patterns from noise by finding the largest ratio gap in descending-sorted episode counts. Called to determine what constitutes abnormally high recurrence.

public_api.name: build_mask
public_api.role: Constructs an array of uint8 grade codes (NO_FLAG, FABRICATED, SUSPECT_FLAT, DEGRADED) for each frame by identifying attractor-based patterns and their surrounding halos. Internal workhorse called by grade_track.

public_api.name: grade_track
public_api.role: Main entry point: grades a canonical track and returns frame-aligned codes plus diagnostics. Uses memoized caching keyed by track content hash and window size.

public_api.name: clear_cache
public_api.role: Clears the in-memory detector cache. Used for isolated test runs to avoid cross-test contamination.

public_api.name: code_counts
public_api.role: Counts how many frames received each of the four grade codes. Called to summarize the results of grading.
